author: codex-organism-core-build
criterion: Ponte comum de atividade reutiliza MemoryStore/MissionController: identidade/revisao, requisitos, progresso, candidatos, delegacoes, retomada, parada e invalidacao; sem autoaprovacao de modelo nem segundo banco. Testes de concorrencia/falha/isolacao e baixo custo medido.
changes: ActivityRuntime: explicit authenticated/delegated/system origin; immutable scoped artifact envelope; same-context request requirements and leases.
Durable unique intents; CAS replay refuses second dispatch; post-intent snapshot validation; pending/uncertain handles recover without resend.
Complete persists candidate before freshness checks, retries only local custody CAS, reconciles crash after submit, and submits only terminal result with no unresolved own operation.
Explicit mechanical refresh; steering includes authenticated decisions/errata/pending; epoch/lease/hold/dependencies and admission source pins validated.
Public snapshot helpers preserve legacy API and compose content plus mission from a single verified snapshot; overflow explicit.
limitations: Server wrappers must authenticate scope, actor, origin and stable request/operation IDs. Ticket is not an authentication token.
Per-request criterion is operational bookkeeping; scientific decomposition remains explicit through existing MissionController.
Preflight cannot make an external provider call atomic with SQLite; uncertainty stays durable and never authorizes automatic retry.
Artifacts and ledger grow; private small-store timing measures local projection only, not provider tokens or unlimited scale.
Integrations A/N/Q, independent review V and installation D remain separate. No scientific/kernel/gate changes.
